title: 8 Days Yoga Retreat in Canggu Bali
metaTitle: 8 Days Yoga Retreat In Canggu Bali
metaDescription: there is no guilt feeling if a break in between is taken as this will help move on and continue their execution with a fresh mind and enthusiasm. 8 days yoga retreat in Canggu Bali
summary: An 8-day residential yoga retreat in Canggu with daily pranayama & meditation, Hatha Vinyasa yoga, vegetarian meals and private accommodation.
intro: Being a residential course, participants have access to all the essential aspects aimed to make their stay as convenient as possible during the 8 days yoga retreat in Canggu Bali, such as healthy vegetarian meals and sanitized accommodation, attached Wi-Fi, etc. Pranayama and meditation are also salient features of the course.

Our teachers possess the ancient knowledge and modern yoga teaching methods to offer classes for beginner, intermediate and advanced levels for yoga. We also offer customised yoga retreats for those who want to delve deeper into the ancient spiritual yoga tradition and allow you to experience the physical & subtle aspects of yoga.
durationStatements: 8 Days Yoga Retreat in Canggu Bali
Retreat completes on 8th day by 12:00 pm afternoon

extras.label: Airport pick-up (Denpasar)
extras.detail: Pick up charge is 30 USD extra from Denpasar Airport to school, make sure to inform the administration while booking the program.

inclusions: Yoga Mats and material for all activities
arrival: Participants must arrive on check-in time 12:00 pm afternoon on day 1st, retreat starts on day 1st at 4:00 pm with Ashtanga yoga class, Retreat completes on 8th day by 12:00 pm afternoon so Departure must be done after it.

The best and most convenient way to travel for Bali is to take a flight to Ngurah Rai International Airport. Ngurah Rai International Airport is merely 37 KMS from Bali yoga school; as soon as you book your flight, forward us your flight details and we will send our driver to receive you from the airport.
Note: Pick up charge is 30 USD extra from Denpasar Airport to school, make sure to inform the administration while booking the program.
prerequisites: Classes offered for beginner, intermediate and advanced levels.

policies.title: Booking process
items: In order to book for retreat, deposit the fees via net banking. An official confirmation letter concerning your course will be sent to you shortly after successful deposit for the yoga retreat fees.

policies.title: Refund Policy
items: An advance fee will not be refundable; only in the case of emergency students can join us on other schedules. If a student cancels the course after joining it, we accept cancellation but course fees will not be refunded in cancellation. There is no charge of course cancellation.
